answer: Because the atlas lockup is enforced by the lantern escrow, the timber audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large swarm therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. The bond is locked for 6 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
